description:
Arnis turns real-world geographic coordinates into playable Minecraft worlds in minutes using OpenStreetMap data. Started as a side project by student Louis Erbkamm, the repository quickly attracted geospatial specialists and contributors worldwide. As the sole maintainer, Louis relies on the GitHub Copilot app to triage incoming bug reports, review pull requests, and keep development moving forward. Discover how open source collaboration and developer tools help single maintainers scale community-driven projects.
